name: Orange Marmalade
source:
Space Sheriff Leona avenges evil organization "Flumers" who destroyed her homeland star. After that days start to pass peacefully. One day she receives a request to find a disappeared girl. Mysterious videotape is sent to sheriff office where girl is insulted by a space monster. Leona takes her laser gun and gets back in action.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
宇宙刑警蕾欧娜向毁灭其故乡星球的邪恶组织“弗鲁默斯”复仇后，重新过上了平静的生活。一天，她接到寻找一名失踪少女的委托。随后，一盘神秘录像带被寄到宇宙刑警办事处，画面中的少女正遭到宇宙怪物凌辱。蕾欧娜拿起激光枪，再次投入行动。

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
